{{Top|leg}}
An '''identification chip''' was a security device that could be used to grant access to authorized personnel. Identification chips were scanned by [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], and appropriate personnel were alerted if individuals entered secure areas without the chips.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Identification chips were installed in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinders]], listing an [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] identity and security clearances. The security stations and [[Prison/Legends|detention blocks]] of Imperial installations had sensor capable of scanning for identification chips built into [[automated laser trap]]s.<ref name="EGWT" />

The [[Private Craft Terminal]] at [[Lola Curich Starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] required an identification chip to enter. Identification chips were issued by either the government, or from the owner of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] berthed in the Terminal.<ref name="ML">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref>
